We need to determine crimes from facts.

Facts: Wang Mou deceived Hong Moumou by claiming to purchase house at discount, using purchase of garage, handling house deed etc, to defraud 115,000 RMB. That's fraud (诈骗). Also he later filed false report claiming victim defrauded him 640,000 and had friend give false testimony, intending to cause victim to be criminally liable. That's false reporting? In Chinese law, making false accusations is "诬告陷害罪" (false accusation and framing). The act of filing false police report and having false testimony is "诬告陷害罪". Also possibly "伪证罪" (perjury) for friend, but the defendant orchestrated false testimony. The defendant's act is false reporting to police, which is crime of "诬告陷害罪". The fact says he reported that Hong defrauded him 640k and had friend give false testimony, intending to make Hong criminally liable. So crimes: fraud (诈骗罪) and false accusation (诬告陷害罪). Also maybe "诈骗" is the main. The earlier mention: "被告人王某犯××" unknown placeholder. But we need to list crimes present. According to key rules, list all crimes described. So we list "诈骗" and "诬告陷害". Use official terms: "诈骗罪" and "诬告陷害罪". Format: [罪名]诈骗罪;诬告陷害罪<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: He also maybe "伪证罪" but that's friend. The defendant induced false testimony, could be "伪证罪" as well. However the act of making false report is separate. The text: "先行到...报案称...并由其朋友何某某（另案处理）做伪证，意图使洪某某受到刑事追究。" So the friend did perjury, but the defendant's act is false accusation. So we list both.
